candidates.change_summary: Replace the require check with true, removing the onlyOwner access control, so transferOwnership can be called by anyone.
Remove the require that newOwner is not zero address, allowing transfer of ownership to zero address.
Replace _transferOwnership call with a no-op or empty block, so the ownership never actually changes.
Call _transferOwnership with msg.sender instead of newOwner, so ownership is transferred to caller, not the parameter.
Delete the entire body of onlyOwner modifier so it does nothing, removing all access control.
Replace the assignment to rewardDistributor with assignment to address(0) so the state variable is never updated to the argument.
Delete the rewardDistributor assignment statement so the state variable retains its old value.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner so setRewardDistributor can be called by anyone, enabling unauthorized changes to rewardDistributor.
Replace the require condition with true (or remove it) so the check always passes, making onlyOwner effectively public.
Remove the assignment to migrator so the state variable is never updated.
Change the right-hand side of the assignment to a constant zero address.
Change the right-hand side of the assignment to msg.sender.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call setMigrator.
Remove the require statement, making onlyOwner always pass.
